note: First version: the pinned bar (a search field, view chips) that layouts wrap in a page-coloured Box under a core://Sticky of their own

component.doc: A bar pinned to the top of a scrolling column while the rest scrolls under it: its one child (a search field, view or filter chips, or both in a core://Column) on the page colour, so rows pass behind the bar rather than through it, 4 dp above and below. Put it first in the column that scrolls (not inside a core://List).

params.name: background
params.doc: The bar's colour, a theme token; the page colour so it matches what is under it.

params.name: padding_v
params.doc: Space above and below the child in dp.

examples.note: a search field that stays in reach while the list under it scrolls
view chips pinned over the list they switch
